headline: An AI traffic camera in Bengaluru allegedly mistook a guitar on a rider's back for a passenger and triggered a ₹500 fine.
score_reason: Pool 2 lowered 1: the incident was on 15 Sep 2026, before 7 Oct (stale); the rider says the challan was later revoked.
importance_line: It shows what can go wrong when AI traffic cameras issue fines, which matters most to drivers who may be fined in error; police say detections are checked by people before a fine is issued, and the rider says this case was put right.
summary: Pune Pulse reports, citing a rider's own X post, that an AI traffic camera in Bengaluru allegedly mistook a guitar on his back for a helmetless pillion passenger, and that his wife received a ₹500 challan. The incident was reportedly on 15 Sep 2026; the rider later confirmed the challan had been revoked, and police say detected violations are checked by people before a fine is issued.
